title: The 'Dark Flow' That Drags Galaxies Into an Unknown Void
hook: Something beyond the observable universe is pulling entire galaxy clusters towards it—and we have no idea what it is.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a hidden, invisible structure pulling galaxies taps into cosmic horror and the unknown, triggering deep curiosity.

title: The 'Extinction Star' That Erupted False Dawns for a Week
hook: A star so bright it turned night into day for seven days—then vanished, leaving behind a dead solar system.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual imagery of a star outshining the sun for days is shocking and easily visualized, perfect for short-form video.

title: The Signal That Came From a Dead Galaxy—227 Years Late
hook: A radio signal from a galaxy that no longer exists reached Earth—and its message was a countdown.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines time travel, death, and mystery—a signal from a dead source is highly eerie and shareable.

title: The Classified 'Gravity Weapon' That Warped Satellite Orbits
hook: A secret space test bent gravity so violently that three spy satellites fell out of orbit—and no one admitted it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy angles about hidden weapons in space always drive engagement, especially with real satellite failures.

title: The Asteroid That Entered a Quantum State—And Split in Two
hook: An asteroid that shouldn't exist simultaneously appeared in two places at once—then collided with itself.
why_this_can_go_viral: Quantum physics applied to a space rock is mind-bending and controversy-sparking, perfect for debate in comments.

title: The 'Oxygen Extinction'—When Earth Almost Breathed Fire
hook: Oxygen levels rose so high 300 million years ago that trees grew to 40 meters—and the atmosphere ignited.
why_this_can_go_viral: Dramatic visuals of a flammable Earth and giant insects tap into prehistoric fascination and disaster appeal.

title: The 'Dark Matter Cannon'—A Cosmic Jet That We Can't See
hook: A gamma ray jet invisible to all telescopes is carving through space—and it might be aimed at us.

title: The Secret 'Dead Man's Switch' Inside Every Galaxy
hook: Astronomers think there's a hidden mechanism that destroys galaxies when civilizations reach a certain point.
why_this_can_go_viral: Fermi paradox with a dark twist—suggests a cosmic 'kill switch' that instantly engages audiences interested in alien life.

title: The 'Ghost Signal' That Pinged from Inside the Sun
hook: A radio signal with no known source emerged from the Sun's core—and it repeated every 11 minutes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Signal from inside our own star is deeply unsettling and invites alien/simulation theories, highly shareable.

title: The Planet That Shouldn't Exist—And Orbits Backward
hook: A gas giant orbits its star in reverse, defying every law of planet formation—and it's getting closer to us.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual spectacle of a backward-orbiting planet is easy to animate and sparks intuitive 'how?' questions.

title: The 'Silent Extinction'—When a Gamma Ray Hit Earth's Blind Side
hook: A gamma ray burst struck Earth 450 million years ago—but only wiped out life on one side of the planet.
why_this_can_go_viral: Unique angle on extinction—asymmetric death is eerie and visually compelling for animation.

title: The Classified 'Space Minefield' That Orbited Earth in the 70s
hook: The US and USSR secretly scattered thousands of explosive satellites in orbit—and some are still active.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cold war secrecy + ongoing danger = high conspiracy appeal and current relevance for space debris concerns.

title: The 'Star That Ate Its Own Planet'—And Burped a Signal
hook: A star swallowed a gas giant whole, and the resulting belch sent a signal across the galaxy we almost interpreted as alien.
why_this_can_go_viral: Grim and slightly humorous imagery of a star 'burping' after eating a planet is highly shareable and memorable.

title: The 'Dark Matter Star' That Emits Nothing but Gravity
hook: A star made entirely of dark matter exists—invisible, cold, and radiating only gravitational waves.
why_this_can_go_viral: The concept of an invisible star challenges basic understanding, prompting shares and discussions.

title: The Asteroid That Gave Earth Its Moon—And Almost Killed Us
hook: The impact that created the Moon also nearly evaporated all life—and it happened not once, but twice.
why_this_can_go_viral: Moon origin with a near-death twist offers a fresh angle on a familiar topic.

title: The 'Classified Shuttle Mission' That Photographed Alien Structures
hook: A 1990s space shuttle mission secretly snapped photos of a structure on the Moon—then the photos were classified.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy-driven content about hidden Moon photos is consistently viral; dark and mysterious.

title: The 'Death Comet' That's in a Suicide Orbit Around Jupiter
hook: A comet is spiraling into Jupiter—and when it hits, the explosion will be visible from Earth with the naked eye.
why_this_can_go_viral: Dramatic countdown to a visible cosmic event creates urgency and anticipation.

title: The Signal That Was a 'Mirror Image' of Earth's First Broadcast
hook: A signal arrived that perfectly mirrored humanity's first radio transmission—but reversed in time.
why_this_can_go_viral: Time reversal and mirroring of human history taps into deep philosophical and sci-fi curiosity.

title: The 'Hidden Star' That Will Trigger a Comet Shower in 100 Years
hook: A dim red dwarf is approaching the Oort Cloud—and in 100 years, it will send a wave of comets toward Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Countdown to a future catastrophe (100 years) feels urgent and ominous, drives shares.

title: The 'Classified Orbital Weapon' That Could Destroy a City in Seconds
hook: A declassified document revealed a space-based kinetic weapon that could strike any city in 10 minutes—with no warning.
why_this_can_go_viral: Real-world secret space weapons are terrifying and generate high engagement from conspiracy and defense audiences.

title: The 'Ghost Galaxy' That Appears and Disappears Every 50 Years
hook: A galaxy that flickers in and out of existence—astronomers think it's being lensed by an invisible black hole.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual of a galaxy vanishing and reappearing is stunning and mysterious, great for animations.

title: The 'Extinction Event' That Was Triggered by Earth Passing Through a Nebula
hook: The solar system drifted through a dense gas cloud 2 million years ago—and it nearly stripped Earth's atmosphere.
why_this_can_go_viral: Little-known extinction mechanism feels fresh and scientifically credible, sparks 'what if' discussions.

title: The 'Silent Threat'—A Rogue Planet That Will Enter Our System in 500 Years
hook: A planet without a star is heading straight for the solar system—and when it arrives, it will destabilize every orbit.
why_this_can_go_viral: Countdown to a planet entering our system is dramatic and easily visualized; taps into 'Planet X' lore.
